verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, an autogenerated OpenAPI 3.0 spec, an official CLI and an MCP server, but nothing about official SDKs or client libraries for any language. The OpenAPI spec is only a building block a developer could use to generate a client, and the CLI and MCP server are separate capabilities, so none of them count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
